# Kishore Theiveekan

## Case studies
- [MES Product Site](https://kishore-theiveekan.vercel.app/work/mes-product-site): A manufacturing execution product presented in 3D.
- [ERP Product Platform](https://kishore-theiveekan.vercel.app/work/erp-product-platform): Content as data. Quality checks as build steps.
- [Privacy Advisory · 19 languages](https://kishore-theiveekan.vercel.app/work/privacy-advisory-site): A build gate that blocks blank pages in 19 languages.
- [Consent Product Site](https://kishore-theiveekan.vercel.app/work/consent-product-site): A consent product site with no cookies and 9 KB of JavaScript.
- [Security Platform + QA Loop](https://kishore-theiveekan.vercel.app/work/security-platform-qa): A 57-route site verified by an automated design-QA process.
- [Jarvis Assistant](https://kishore-theiveekan.vercel.app/work/jarvis-assistant): A local-first AI assistant with three model backends.
- [Finstein.ai Corporate Site](https://kishore-theiveekan.vercel.app/work/finstein-corporate-site): A corporate site kept fast and secure without a framework.
- [Finstein Cyber Website](https://kishore-theiveekan.vercel.app/work/finstein-cyber-website): 20 pages assembled by a bespoke component build.
- [Security & Delivery Loop](https://kishore-theiveekan.vercel.app/work/security-delivery-loop): From VAPT finding to verified production change, across 11 repositories.
- [Compliance Platform Site](https://kishore-theiveekan.vercel.app/work/compliance-platform-site): A 59-page site moved to Next.js with every page intact.
